_method: Labels assigned by viewing scratch/bl684/plots/blind_*.png BEFORE looking at detector output. Plots carried no detector marker and no filename beyond the last 6 digits of pk. Judgement = 'is there a sustained level jump that HOLDS, of the kind an editor would cut on in a CapCut waveform'.
_grades: clear = unmistakable sustained step | marginal = a level change is arguably there but I would not stake a cut on it | flat = no sustained up-step (uniform, or only dips/recoveries/ramps)
_caveat: This is a machine-vision reading of a rendered envelope, NOT a human video editor's eye. It is a better proxy than synthetic ground truth and a worse one than an editor.
